t: Siglin sleds | Alaska Outdoors Forums
s: October 4, 2010 - Of all the sleds I've used, the only one I have are the UHMW tubs, what you call a Siglin. They pull extremely smooth, are quiet, and flex with the trail. Breakables like eggs either go in the middle or further back. Yes, you can still break them, but normally they do well where I go. I saw a couple for sale this past summer for a few hundred bucks. I did not buy them as I currently have 3 good ones.
